newsitem.title: UK: UK gilts end flat, underperform perky Europe.
newsitem.headline: UK gilts end flat, underperform perky Europe.

text.p: UK gilts ended Friday's session unchanged having languished in negative territory for much of the day.

They were buoyed in afternoon trade by soft U.S. producer prices data, but underperformed French and German bonds which made hearty gains on renewed hopes that the Amsterdam summit at the weekend would clear up their difficulties over the stability pact for monetary union
"That still doesn't explain why the UK should underperform, because gilts look good under both the soft EMU and hard EMU scenarios," said one futures broker.
Last monday, French finance minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said France could not sign the EMU stability pact at Amsterdam because he had not yet consulted Parliament.

The main focus for UK gilts next week will be PSBR and retail sales data. The PSBR is forecast at 2.0 billion pounds, while retail sales are forecast to rise 0.2 percent on the month for year-on-year growth of 4.5 percent. The data are due at 0830 GMT on Tuesday and Wednesday respectively.
"The retail sales data are more important for gilts. It will be the first time we see if windfall payments have been spent in the shops," said one trader.
The yield spread between gilts and Bunds widened to 148 basis points from 145 on Thursday.
